title: Jagged Crispy Spanish Potatoes Patatas Bravas
description: A sweet and crispy Spanish dish featuring pico de gallo sauce and toast, perfect for a sick day, and dairy-free-friendly. This patatas bravas recipe is a twist on the classic Spanish dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until crispy.
While the potatoes are roasting, toast the bread until it is crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a slice of toasted bread on a plate, then top with a spoonful of pico de gallo sauce, and finally add a few pieces of the crispy potatoes.
Repeat the layers until all of the ingredients have been used up.
